d: Long, light cornflower blue hair is styled with blunt bangs and a single thick braid draped over one shoulder. The eyes are a vibrant cerulean blue with a gentle, smiling expression on a youthful, mature face. The build is slender, wearing a white, blue, and orange sleeveless high-collar dress with a pleated skirt, paired with black thigh-high stockings and black mechanical high-heeled boots. A black mechanical gauntlet covers the left arm, and a blue translucent hair ornament sits atop the head.
